description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM is hiring a QA/Test Developer for its Infrastructure & Technology organization. The role supports testing standards, exploratory testing, test automation, defect analysis, and collaboration on product stories from definition through deployment.
QA/Test Developer supporting testing standards, exploratory defect discovery, root-cause prevention, and adoption of unit, integration, and functional automation

Responsibilities:
• Learn and assist in developing testing standards and applying quality technologies to ensure the product is robust and failure scenarios are considered and refactored
• Engage in exploratory testing using industry-leading practices to discover defects/bugs and collaborate with coders and POs to determine root cause and prevention methods
• Assist in driving the adoption of test automation, including unit tests, integration tests, and functional tests
• Participate in collaborating with cross-functional team members on story development, from before definition through final deployment
• Contribute to identifying defects/bugs and work with coders and POs to determine root cause and prevention methods

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Familiarity with working in an agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and adapting to changing requirements
• Knowledge of testing standards, quality technologies, and industry-leading practices for exploratory testing
• Awareness of test automation concepts, including unit tests, integration tests, and functional tests
• Basic understanding of defect identification, root cause analysis, and prevention methods
• Familiarity with tools and platforms used for collaboration and communication among cross-functional teams
• you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Exposure to industry-leading practices for exploratory testing and test automation, including unit tests, integration tests, and functional tests
• Knowledge of quality technologies and testing standards, including their application in ensuring product robustness and failure scenario refactoring
• Familiarity with tools and techniques used for defect identification, root cause analysis, and prevention methods
